name: Hongrie
description: Point de Hongrie parquet: planks mitered into stacked chevrons, every plank its own shade of oak, honey and walnut.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0%; top: -100%; width: 100%; height: 200%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--hl); clip-path: @var(--hl); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0%; top: -100%; width: 100%; height: 200%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--hr); clip-path: @var(--hr); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
